status: focused implementation and verification complete; full regression, independent review and integration pending
cause: Closing the editor during either export picker does not prevent export_folder from consuming the returned value and submitting a new export job. The import and sprite picker paths also consumed results after local closure.

before.surface: offscreen Qt, real export worker and temporary filesystem, injected picker results
before.parent_picker_close: Opened the name prompt after reject and created pet.json.
before.import_action_regression: 6 failed, 18 deselected in 2.17s; submitted import job, changed sprite draft or accessed destroyed child widget.

after.fix: Check local closed state, Qt validity and owner admission before export/import/sprite pickers and after every picker return.
after.same_reproduction: Both closed editors create no output; closing during the parent picker opens no name prompt.
after.cases: 12 close cases across parent/name/import/sprite pickers and reject/reject-plus-destruction/direct destruction; 4 live cancellation/retry cases use real import/export and exact image comparison.

pending: Full regression, independent review and integration.
limits: No OS picker automation, all-language/DPI or screen-reader acceptance. Prior frozen worktree unchanged. No EXE conversion.

native.scope: Traditional Chinese dark 900x740, private Windows desktop, actual MainUI owner and cached editor reopened four times. Editor opened through page method; editor buttons activated with local Tab/Space. Picker returns injected; no OS input.
native.shutdown: Normal runtime closure, temporary settings removed, blank stderr, independent process reopens exact world/profiles/save and reacquires leases.
